about: Examples of watermarks that write the picture's own details, for the Watermark tab: each is a preset of a marker (an SVG from the watermarks folder, see docs/watermarks.md) with its position, size and colour, and it clears the canister and the camera and lens text so the watermark is just this one. The words come from the Roll Card and the frame through $(NAME) variables, so one preset writes the right film, camera, lens and year on every picture of a roll. Fill in the Roll Card first, and press Variables... in the Watermark tab to see what a picture will say.

presets.name: Watermarks (EFAS Examples)/Film credit, bottom left, light
presets.description: The EFAS film credit in white at the bottom left: the film and ISO in bold, the camera and lens, and the date and Edited with EFAS in small letters, from the Roll Card and the frame. Marker efas-film-credit.svg.

presets.name: Watermarks (EFAS Examples)/Film credit, bottom left, dark
presets.description: The same film credit in black, for a bright picture. Marker efas-film-credit.svg.

presets.name: Watermarks (EFAS Examples)/Film and camera line, bottom centre
presets.description: Two quiet lines in the middle of the bottom edge: the film with its ISO, and the camera with its lens. Marker film-frame-info.svg.

presets.name: Watermarks (EFAS Examples)/Copyright line, bottom right
presets.description: (c) and the year of the frame (this year if it has no date) and your name, at the bottom right. Replace the example name in the marker's Text box of the Watermark tab. Marker copyright-line.svg.

presets.name: Watermarks (EFAS Examples)/Roll and frame line, top left
presets.description: A line of text with variables in it: the roll's name (the folder's, if the Roll Card has none), the frame's number and the file name, in small letters at the top left. Marker simple-text.svg: edit its Text box in the Watermark tab and use any variable from Variables....
